name: EH3D-STENCILCAM
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.5: a library and a command line that turn the pads of a paste layer (read with the Gerber reader of EH3D-CORE-LIBS and turned into shapes by EH3D-GERBERVIEWER) into the openings of a solder paste stencil: each is shrunk by a percentage for the material, rounded, reduced by the kerf of the laser, checked against the aspect and area ratios that decide whether the paste leaves the opening, and written as G-code for a laser or HP-GL for a plotter, mirrored for the bottom side if asked. Macro pads, tracks and regions are not turned into openings and a polygon pad is cut as a circle; nothing has been cut. A window (egui, built with the gui feature: open or drop a layer, choose the material, edit the parameters, see the pads and the cutting paths, export) is written and its logic is tested, but it has not been looked at on a screen.
